title: IBM security advisory (AV26-1162)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1162 Date: November 16, 2026 As of November 13, 2026, IBM is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: App Connect Operator Prior to or equal to 12.0.28 Prior to or equal to 12.21.0 Prior to or equal to 13.6.0 ContextForge MCP Gateway Prior to or equal to 1.1.0 Security QRadar EDR Prior to or equal to 3.12.26 webMethods Integration Server Prior to or equal to 10.15_Core_Fix2 Prior to or equal to 11.1_Core_Fix11 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Security Bulletin: IBM App Connect Enterprise Certified Container operator and operands are vulnerable to loss of confidentiality and denial of service due to multiple CVEs Security Bulletin: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway is affected by an information exposure vulnerability Security Bulletin: IBM webMethods Integration Server is vulnerable to sensitive information disclousure via admin/server/env API request. CVE-2026-123628 Security Bulletin: IBM Security QRadar EDR Software has vulnerabilities that could allow security restrictions to be bypassed and sensitive information to be disclosed.
